defects.defect: The AskCoworker claim that SendCustomNotification/ISendCustomNotification is an in-app notification framework cannot be checked, because both class bodies are hidden (managed). The spec labels the claim 'reported by AskCoworker' but does not say the body is unreadable.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: no instruction to note when an AskCoworker claim targets a component whose body is hidden and so cannot be verified.

defects.defect: Q1 (native Slack app connection vs webhook named credential) is asked as a pick-an-option question with a recommended default. The real unknown is the environment fact of whether a Slack workspace is connected, and that could have been asked directly. The user answered 'no preference', and the design is still Conditional on the unverified connection.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: SKILL.md does not separate an environment-fact question (is X connected?) from an implementation-choice question.
